The New gTLD Program
The New Generic Top-Level Domains (gTLD) Program:
2026
Round is
an ICANN initiative
to enable the expansion of the Internet's Domain Name System (DNS) through the introduction of new top-level domains.
Applicant Support Program (ASP)
The Applicant Support Program (ASP) is an initiative intended to provide financial and non-financial support for eligible entities that demonstrate financial need.
Registry Service Provider (RSP)
The RSP Evaluation Program evaluates organizations regarding the technical aspects of operating a gTLD. All new gTLD applicants are required to use evaluated RSPs. The List of Evaluated RSPs can be found
here
.
2026 Round Information
The 2026 Round new gTLD application window opens 30 April through 12 August 2026. Find more information here.
Interested in applying for a new gTLD?
Find out how your organization can participate and the steps you can take to prepare to apply for a new gTLD.
Apply for a new gTLD.
Review the application submission processes and apply through the TLD Application Management System (TAMS).
